THE STORY

A FOOL, A SKY GOD, AND FIVE THINGS HE SHOULD NOT HAVE TOUCHED

Ananse is the village fool, and Krom's only scout, a job he took before he understood what it involved. Trying to save the village from disaster he destroys a sacred statue instead, and ends up in a cell awaiting judgment from Onyame, the Sky God. What should have been punishment turns into an unlikely friendship.

He steals the divine relics and spends them on a hunt for respect, until the village he wanted to impress throws him out. When it is finally threatened, the fool they exiled is the only one who can save it.

EVERY EPISODE recovers one lost lesson: wisdom, greed, empathy, honesty.
LOOK DEVELOPMENT

PAINTED, NOT RENDERED

Hand-painted texture work carried through an in-engine post-process material that lays pencil marks over the frame and flattens the depth, so the render reads closer to a moving illustration than to 3D.

THE WORLD

PAINTED FIRST, BUILT SECOND

Krom and everything in it exists as painting before it exists in engine. Adinkra geometry, Kente structure and historic West African architecture, authored as material and shader work rather than applied as decoration.

KROM

The village, from above. Earthen architecture, a divine tree, and the statue at the centre of everything.

THE HIGHLANDS

The boulder blocking the river. The reason a scout who never scouts is finally sent out.

THE ARRIVAL

The final beat of Episode 1: a silhouette in the doorway, no face, no dialogue.

TAKEN FROM ONYAME'S REALM

FIVE STOLEN RELICS

POT OF WISDOM

Makes the holder the wisest man alive, and shatters the moment he forgets he was ever a fool.

BRACERS OF MIGHT

The strength of a hundred men, and divine enough to let go mid-lift.

ROBE OF SECRETS

Hides the wearer from sight, which is how a forgotten spirit gets someone to listen.

CLOAK OF INVISIBILITY

Vanishes a man until it decides his spirit is too deceitful to carry.

DANCING DRUMS

Every beat forces whoever hears it to dance, the thief included.

SEASON ONE

TEN EPISODES, TEN LOST LESSONS

EPISODE 1 THE PILOT, IN PRODUCTION

BROKEN WISDOM

Ananse is a man of low standing in the village, mocked for being neither strong nor brave. In a desperate attempt to prove his worth during the worst drought in history, he breaks a sacred law and lands in prison. But fate flips the script when his punishment leads him to Onyame, the almighty Sky God, who unexpectedly takes a liking to him. Through this divine friendship, Ananse learns of mystical relics hidden in Onyame's realm and secretly steals five.

He uses the Pot of Wisdom and becomes the wisest man in the village. Ananse lets his newfound intellect inflate his ego. He manipulates and deceives others for personal gain, mistaking cunning for greatness. But his arrogance backfires and he shatters the Pot in a careless act, releasing its wisdom across the world. Stripped of his edge, Ananse tries to outsmart the villagers one last time but ends up humiliated and chased from town.

Wisdom misused becomes foolishness in disguise.
EPISODE 6

EXILED TO THE WILD

After the Dancing Drums incident, the Elders have had enough. Ananse is publicly shamed and officially exiled from the village. With no more relics and privileges, he stumbles into the forest, alone and angry. But in this new world, trickery won't put food in his belly or keep the cold away.

Forced to fend for himself, Ananse learns the harsh realities of survival. He tries to outsmart wild animals and quickly learns that things do not work that way in the forest. Hungry, cold, and humbled, he begins to change. Slowly, he learns to observe, adapt, and live in harmony with the land. He starts to farm small plots, learns to fish, sets clever traps, and even builds a sturdy shelter.

For the first time in his life, Ananse earns everything he has. Through his honest effort, his body becomes stronger, and his mind sharper. He begins to appreciate the quiet rhythm of a life lived with integrity.

Sometimes, losing everything is how we discover our true strength.
EPISODE 10 · FINALE

DANCE OF THE BRAVE

With the legendary beast now at the village gates, Ananse fights bravely to protect his people, but he's quickly overwhelmed. Just when it seems all hope is lost, his family arrives at his side, refusing to abandon him. Next the descendants of the spirit he freed.

Together, they battle the beast with everything they've got, holding the line with raw courage and unity. In the chaos, Ananse spots something sticking out of the ground, the second Dancing Drum he had buried and forgotten. He signals to his son, and what follows is a tense, high-speed game of survival as his family dodges the rampaging beast to retrieve the drum. By the skin of their teeth, they manage to get the drum to Ananse. He beats the drum and the mighty beast begins to dance. Awkward. Confused. Hilarious. The once terrifying beast has become a pathetic spectacle.

Slowly, the villagers reemerge, emboldened by Ananse's show of bravery. They rally behind him and for the first time Ananse leads as they chase the beast back into the depths of the forest. That night, Onyame appears, proud. Ananse is no longer the trickster who relied on stolen relics. He has grown. With heart, courage, and the help of his family, he saved the village. Onyame appoints him Guardian of Krom.

True greatness is not given, it's earned, through trials, growth, and determination.

MADE IN UNREAL

REAL TIME MAKES IT POSSIBLE

A hundred and fifty minutes of animation on an offline-render pipeline needs a render farm, a technical director and a licence stack a studio in Accra cannot buy. Real time closes that gap.

THE WORLD GETS RELEASED, FREE

Every environment, prop, material and set piece built for Krom goes out free and downloadable. If you are building anything set in Africa, the asset libraries do not have you. We are building all of it anyway.

The world goes out. The hero characters and the story stay with the production.

THE ASK

$75,000 BUILDS ONE EPISODE, NOT THE SERIES

The grant produces Episode 1 as a complete fifteen-minute pilot, built end to end in Unreal Engine, releases the world we build for it as a free asset library, and documents the build publicly. Twelve months.

Deliberately not the full series. The ten-episode budget is $400,000 and we are not asking Epic to carry it. The pilot is the piece that makes the rest financeable.

Animation and character build$23,000
Direction and in-engine production$13,000
World and environment build$10,000
Sound, score and voice$10,000
Hardware and software$9,000
Community program$5,000
Delivery and contingency$5,000
TOTAL REQUESTED$75,000

If a hardware grant is available, the hardware line converts and the cash redirects into animation time.
